chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak (I think), from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
The broth of the meat of the cow does away with the whiteness (vitiligo).

key_terms.الْبَيَاضِ: Whiteness, referring to vitiligo (a skin condition)
key_terms.مَرَقُ: Broth or soup made from meat

ai.seo_question: What is the medicinal benefit of cow meat broth according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the broth of cow meat as a remedy for vitiligo (*al-bayad*), reflecting the Shia tradition of linking dietary habits to physical healing. This specific medical insight is often contextualized within the broader Islamic understanding of *tadawi* (seeking cure) through natural means, emphasizing the holistic view of the body and soul in Shia jurisprudence and medicine.
